summary: Retrieves timing, tempo, phase, beat, and status channels from an Ableton Link session on the local network for sync-driven TouchDesigner systems.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Turn the CHOP output on or off

key_params.name: enable
key_params.note: Initialize the connection to the Ableton Link session

key_params.name: startstopsync
key_params.note: Share start and stop state with compatible Link peers

key_params.name: callbacks
key_params.note: Callbacks DAT for events received from the Link session

key_params.name: status
key_params.note: Output status channels such as numpeers, linked, waiting, and synced

key_params.name: tempo
key_params.note: Output the current Link tempo in BPM

key_params.name: rampbar
key_params.note: Output a normalized ramp over each bar

key_concepts: Enable initializes the Link session connection
status channels: numpeers, linked, waiting, synced
tempo, phase, beat, bar, ramp, pulse, sine, and count outputs
TDAbleton for deeper Ableton Live integration
common_gotchas: The CHOP only reflects a Link session after Enable is initialized and network peers are discoverable.
Ableton Link timing can be affected by audio driver choice; the official docs call out DirectX driver issues on Ableton's side.
Output channels are opt-in, so downstream plans should enable the status, tempo, beat, phase, or ramp channels they intend to consume.
Start/stop sync is session-wide behavior, not a local transport button; only enable it when peers should share start and stop signals.
